calendar.assumption: Sample dates plus weekdays 2026-06-22..30 and 2026-08-03 treated as trading days for window construction.

windows.pre_open: 前一交易日收盘后至当日开盘前
windows.prior: 此前 2 至 5 个交易日

metadata.decomposition: return = same-date screened sample median (market) + same-industry leave-one-out median minus market (industry) + stock-specific remainder; shares are clipped same-sign fractions.
metadata.scoring: Stock-specific share is divided among direction-consistent present features in proportion to the attributable fraction among the exposed, 1 - 1/LR with LR = P(feature|event)/P(feature|no event) at the event's threshold and direction, shrunk linearly below MIN_SUPPORT observations; features with LR below MIN_LR are listed as weak evidence without credit; trading-flow evidence always receives a floor so every event has a stated reason.

shard_keys.breadth: share of other screened stocks down more than 5%
shard_keys.causes: list of {f: feature, p: probability, w: weight, lr, er: event rate given feature, n: events with feature}
shard_keys.ev: evidence items: announcements inline; news_company and news_industry reference ids in the shard's news dictionary

metadata.shard_files: events/{date}-{level}.json holds the events whose strongest threshold level is 2, 3 or 5 percent; a view at 3 percent needs the 3 and 5 files, a view at 2 percent needs all three.
limitations: 概率是 2026 年 7 月样本内的经验关联，不是因果证明，也未在样本外验证。
公告 99% 以上在收盘后发布，公告类原因主要通过前一交易日收盘后至当日开盘前的窗口起作用；当日收盘后的公告只作为事后解释列出。
新闻来源为财经类公众号文章标题与关联股票标签，关键词识别行业与政策，可能漏判或误判。
行业归属来自公告元数据中的行业标签；无公告的股票没有行业层。
成交与盘口证据来自快照代理指标（tick 规则、笔均额），不能识别交易者身份。
日度观察在当日 16:00 后完整；本页不声称盘中可预测。
